title: Demolition & disposal of damaged old Lighthouse tower of Kiltan (N) Lighthouse, UT of Lakshadweep
summary: Offline sealed percentage-rate tender for manually or mechanically demolishing the damaged old RCC lighthouse tower at Kiltan (North) Lighthouse, Lakshadweep, and disposing of the debris, issued by the Directorate of Lighthouses and Lightships, Cochin.

procurement.issuing_office: Directorate of Lighthouses and Lightships, Cochin

sites.name: Kiltan (N) Lighthouse, Kiltan Island, UT of Lakshadweep
sites.work: Demolition and disposal of damaged old lighthouse tower

scope.item: Demolishing R.C.C. work manually/by mechanical means incl. stacking of steel bars and disposal of unserviceable material within 50 m lead, incl. machinery, labour, tools, scaffolding (rate Rs 6,605/cum; Rs 1,65,125)
Disposal of building rubbish/malba by mechanical means to approved dumping ground beyond 50 m initial lead, all leads and lifts (rate Rs 491/cum; Rs 12,275)

money.notes: Estimated cost taken from schedule total Rs 1,77,400 (amount with taxes). EMD by DD/FDR of any scheduled bank in favour of Director of Lighthouses and Lightships - Cochin, payable at Ernakulam; released after satisfactory completion. Percentage rate (below/above) quoted inclusive of materials, labour, transport, scaffolding and GST. Payment on actual measured quantities; no escalation.

period.completion: 02 months from date of issue of work order

eligibility: Copy of PAN card and bank account details
Lowest amount quoted decides the successful bidder; company bidders need authorization letter

documents.file: Tender Form_Demolition of old Kiltan LH (1).pdf

notes: Blank tender forms issued at Deep Bhavan, Kochi and by the station in-charge (Navigational Assistant Grade-I), Kiltan Lighthouse, 27.07.2024 to 06.08.2024 10:00-16:00; sealed tender to be submitted to station in-charge, Kiltan by 07.08.2024 15:00. Site inspection 27.07.2024 to 06.08.2024. Opening date not printed (clause 8 mentions 16:00 on next working day if holiday). Clause 34 refers to 'this auction'. Debris disposal clearance from local authority is bidder's responsibility. Listing bid_opening 2024-08-07.
